text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir accepts cabinet's resignation. Under the constitution the cabinet has to resign after the results of parliamentary elections are announced.
- Some 125 violations to commerce law by local businesses were registered in September, Commerce and Industry Ministry official says.
- Kuwait takes part in Arab labour conference in Cairo.
- Share index rises as parliamentary elections end.
- New national assembly convenes on October 20.
